prompt: Build a zero-dependency npm library named tiny-slug. `require('tiny-slug')` (CommonJS, main entry in package.json) exports slugify(input, options). It lowercases, strips diacritics (Creme brulee from the accented form), replaces every run of non-alphanumeric characters with the separator, and trims separators at both ends. options.separator defaults to -. options.maxLength truncates the result and then removes any trailing separator. A non-string input throws TypeError. Include tests and a README.

hidden.run: if [ -f setup.sh ]; then sh setup.sh; fi; node tests_hidden/test_slug.js
